name: 3.1 A state, a box and an effect
description: Blank starter: build ψ → f → π and read it in Dirac notation.

exercise.title: A state, a box and an effect
exercise.statement:
In the Diagram Editor, add a **state**, a **box** and an **effect** with the toolbar buttons, and wire them into a column: drag from the state's output handle to the box's input, and from the box's output to the effect. Double-click a node to rename it: call them ψ, f and π.

Now press **Generate** in the Dirac Formula Editor. Compare the order of the symbols in the formula with the order of the boxes in the picture.
exercise.done: Generate shows $\langle \pi | f | \psi \rangle$, and you can say why the formula reads right to left while the diagram reads bottom to top.
